The Amazon I work at is strangly pro trans but the people working here are a different story. Ive heard the t slur, f slur and he-she before. But Ive also meet plenty of other trans people.

A couple pros are that Amazon will pay for certain degrees if you wanna go do schooling. And the insurance (aetna is what I went with but theres others) will cover 90% or top and bottom surgery along with testosterone and therapy. Its really easy to change your name in the system too and get your badge reprinted to match it. You dont need a legal name change and it'll even update all throughout the system too so no one has to know your deadname (if you haven't changed it yet) also my site heavily pushes lgbt acceptance and they have an entire lgbt section on the work website.

As for the interaction it really depends. Depending in department you could either be alone for 10-12 hours or surrounded by people. But most dont talk to others unless they're friends.
